summary: Added a GET /api/orders/export endpoint that streams a CSV of orders matching the same filters as GET /api/orders, backed by a new csvExport service. Added a standalone ExportButton component that calls the export endpoint and triggers a file download.

files_changed.description: buildOrdersCsv(orders) formats an array of order records into CSV text with the required header row.

Added GET /api/orders/export route: applies the same status/dateFrom/dateTo filters as GET /api/orders, passes the result to buildOrdersCsv, and responds with text/csv and a Content-Disposition attachment header.
Added exportOrdersCsv(filters) which calls GET /api/orders/export with the given filters and returns the response blob.
New button component: on click, calls ordersClient.exportOrdersCsv(currentFilters), then creates an object URL from the returned blob and triggers a download via a temporary anchor element.
Added tests for GET /api/orders/export: correct header row, filter pass-through, and empty-result CSV.
Added a unit test for ExportButton in isolation, mocking ordersClient.exportOrdersCsv and asserting the download flow is triggered on click.

tests_added: server/tests/orders.test.js::export returns header-only CSV when no orders match
